description.p: Creates and launches Minecraft instances with Fabric, Quilt, Forge or NeoForge, installs mods and modpacks from Modrinth and CurseForge, manages worlds, backups, servers and skins, and diagnoses crashes.

Crea y lanza instancias de Minecraft con Fabric, Quilt, Forge o NeoForge, instala mods y modpacks de Modrinth y CurseForge, gestiona mundos, copias, servidores y skins, y diagnostica cierres inesperados.
